# Phase 0 extractor reproducers

Small, self-contained C projects that each target one known defect of the
preprocessor-blind extractor (`scripts/build_callgraph_dag.py`). Each one
builds with `make` (`$(CC)`, `-O0 -g`, libc and pthread only). Each has a
`truth.json` holding the exact ground truth of the configured build: functions,
`not_compiled`, edges, externals, link units, entry points and thread entries.

| Dir | Defect(s) | A correct extractor must report |
|---|---|---|
| `r01_static_collision` | 1 (same-named statics) | `skip_ws` in both `src/lexer.c` and `src/emit.c`, and `put` in both `src/emit.c` and `tools/main.c`, as distinct functions. `kv_emit` calls `emit.c#skip_ws` and `main` calls `tools/main.c#put`. |
| `r02_ifdef_config` | 2 (preprocessor, `-D`) | `check_ext_flags` is compiled only because of `-DPROTO_VERSION=2` (the header default is 1). `crc32_init` is compiled, not `adler32`. `posix_read_all` is compiled, not `win_read_all`. `#if 0`, `DEBUG` and `WITH_COMPRESSION` functions are `not_compiled`. `frame_checksum` and `plat_read_file` each have a dead duplicate body that must not add edges. |
| `r03_function_pointers` | 3 (function pointers) | Indirect edges `proto_dispatch` → `h_ping`/`h_echo`/`h_sum` (from the global table) and → `cmp_op` (bsearch). Every `out->write` caller → `write_plain` and `write_hex` (field set at runtime). `proto_list_ops` → `cmp_name` (qsort). `h_reset` is unreferenced: no edge and not an entry point. |
| `r04_public_api` | 4 (entry points) | Entry points are exactly the six `RB_API` functions exported by `libringbuf.so`, plus `main`. This includes `rb_used` and `rb_free_space`, which also have internal callers. It excludes the hidden `rb_util_*` helpers, which are called only from `lib/core/`, another directory. |
| `r05_link_units` | 5 (modules = link units) | Three units. `libcsv.a` = `src/csv.c` + `src/field.c` + `extra/quote.c`, so the library spans two directories. `csvstat` and `csvcut` each have their own `main`, and both live in `src/` next to the library sources. |
| `r06_force_include` | 6 (compile flags) | Preprocessing works only with `-include config.h` (otherwise `#error` fires and `TLV_VERSION_STRING` is undefined), `-iquote src/internal` and `-isystem vendor/include`. Config macros make `walk_nested` compiled (it recurses with `walk_level`) and `tag_known` `not_compiled`. |
| `r07_macro_functions` | 7 (macro-defined functions and calls) | `rec_get_{version,flags,length,seq}` are generated by an X-macro in `src/getters.c` and are public API (declared through a macro). `read_u8/16/32` are generated by `DEFINE_READER` and call `cursor_need`. Calls go through the `READ_FIELD`, `LOG_FAIL` (→ `rec_log_fail`) and `PRINT_FIELD` (token-pasted getter call) macros. |
| `r08_threads` | 8 (threads), 3 | Thread entries are `worker_main` (started in the library by `pool_create`) and `progress_main` (started in the tool by `main`), each with an indirect edge from the function that calls `pthread_create`. Shared state is protected by mutexes. |
| `r09_mixed` | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 (≈460 lines, HTTP/1.x request parser and CLI) | Static `trim` in both `headers.c` and `parser.c`. Chunked decoding exists only because of `-DHTTPP_ENABLE_CHUNKED`, while `HTTPP_WITH_TRAILERS` and `_WIN32` functions are `not_compiled`. `cls_*` predicates are generated by `DEFINE_CLASS`. Callbacks are struct fields set at runtime and called through the variadic `CB_CALL` macro. `httpp_reset` and `httpp_header_get` are public yet also called internally. The library spans `src/` and `compat/`. |

## Conventions used in the truth files

- A function's id is `<path relative to project>#<source name>`. Macro-generated
  functions use the file that holds the macro invocation.
- An `indirect` edge links a function-pointer call site to every function it
  can actually reach in this program. A function passed to
  `pthread_create`, `qsort` or `bsearch` gets an `indirect` edge from the
  function that makes that call.
- `externals` are source-level names. GCC compiles
  `fprintf(stderr, "literal\n")` to `fwrite` even at `-O0`, so `nm` shows
  `U fwrite` where the truth lists `fprintf`.
- `not_compiled` holds only definitions whose id differs from a compiled one.
  The truth `notes` list duplicate `#if`/`#else` bodies of compiled functions.

## Verifying

```sh
docker run --rm --network none -v "<this dir>:/r:ro" --entrypoint sh framac-build:latest \
  -c 'cp -r /r/r01_static_collision /tmp/p && cd /tmp/p && make && nm -A $(find . -name "*.o")'
```

All nine projects build in the build image (`framac-build:latest`; first checked
in the monolithic image, since removed) with no errors or warnings
(`-Wall -Wextra`). For every project, `functions` matches the `T`/`t` symbols
of the object files exactly.
